title: Segment Tree Problem
content:
Given a sequence of positive integers $A=\left\{A_0,A_1,\dots,A_{N-1}\right\}$ and $B=\left\{B_0,B_1,\dots,B_{N-1}\right\}$, process $Q$ queries of the following form:
  1. Given an integer $i\,\,(0\le i\lt N)$ and values of $x$ and $y$, set $A_i=x$ and $B_i=y$.
  2. Given integers $L,R$ satisfying $0\le L\lt R\le N$, output the value of $$\dfrac{\overset{R-1}{\underset{i=L}{\sum}} A_i B_i}{\overset{R-1}{\underset{i=L}{\sum}} B_i}$$
Constraints: $1\le N,Q\le 2\cdot 10^5, \,\, 1\le A_i,B_i \le 10^6$
